description: Step 1 (grilling 2026-10-12): assert_agrees gains forced_yields: true (runs the native side plain and under __defk_force_yields__, both against the oracle; default false) and message: :exact. Defk.Properties.agreement/2 defaults forced_yields: true for kernels that can yield - resume coverage stops depending on hand-written ceremony at the 78 call sites (sites testing yielding itself keep explicit control). Delete test/elixir_mode_test.exs Agree.agree/4 (replaced by message: :exact) and Defk.Case.in_both_modes (4 call sites inline with_mode; already demoted by ADR-0006). Step 2: single-source the runtime error messages between priv/defk_runtime.h and ElixirMode.Ops (generate both from one definition) so both modes raise byte-identical text and the hand-synced @arith/@arg taxonomy in test.ex dies (the defk-euu finding, what crc32c tripped over). CONTEXT 'Agreement' definition unchanged (same module, same reason); identical messages are an implementation strengthening.
title: Deepen assert_agrees: forced_yields and message options; single-source runtime messages
